newsitem.title: MALI: Koumar re-elected Mali president - commission.
newsitem.headline: Koumar re-elected Mali president - commission.

text.p: Malian President Alpha Oumar Konare won a landslide re-election victory with 84,360 votes to 3,570 for businessman Hamadou Maribatrou Diaby, the Independent National Electoral Commission said early on Saturday.
The results of last Sunday's vote were announced on state television by commission president Kassoum Tapo.
The results were being submitted to Mali's constitutional court for approval, Tapo said.
